# varnish / esi_parse_fuzzer

varnish's own fuzz target `esi_parse_fuzzer` ([source](source/esi_parse_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over vinyl-cache (code.vinyl-cache.org/vinyl-cache/vinyl-cache at bc9eaf71).

sets four ESI parser flags from the first input bytes, then VEP_Init/VEP_Parse/VEP_Finish over the whole input with a 1 KiB workspace; the produced ESI vsb is destroyed unread.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against vinyl-cache at commit bc9eaf71.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- VEP_Init returned non-NULL (AN = assert-non-NULL); trivially true for this fixed setup ([line 176](source/esi_parse_fuzzer.c#L176)): assert(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch varnish` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `esi_parse_fuzzer.plain` | 126,176 | `eff2a46f1caf10f56a23834de86db5f8db86ed481f08d534041eb1eec3abaaf8` |
| ubsan | `esi_parse_fuzzer.ubsan` | 127,104 | `f6e305112a92b21d1a13c74996bee4af323e234da0a9137e4b4c40cfa15ebc1e` |
| asan | `esi_parse_fuzzer.asan` | 652,024 | `f31457a9bf11469e2e2d9b203ba5fa431db4cb6cb5baa5b6a2b4ac252f319e4e` |
| asan-ubsan | `esi_parse_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 650,008 | `59f94a66c935aadf1715d4533a18dd1cf70b232cd467ee297de77f2b55358809` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
